description: Correct a diffusion series for eddy currents and head motion with FSL eddy (Apple GPU through eddy_metal when available, else CUDA or CPU), applying a topup field when given. Writes the corrected series with its rotated gradient table, ready for dti-fit, plus eddy's movement and outlier reports.

dwi.description: 4-D diffusion series (NIfTI with its dcm2niix JSON sidecar beside it).

gradients.description: FSL .bval or .bvec of the series (the sibling with the same stem is read too).

mask.description: Brain mask on the dwi grid, e.g. fsl-topup's brain_mask.

topup_fieldcoef.description: fsl-topup's fieldcoef output (topup_movpar.txt must sit beside it).

acqparams.description: fsl-topup's acqparams output; required with topup_fieldcoef.

engine.description: auto (FSL's eddy dispatcher: Metal, then CUDA, then CPU), metal, or cpu.

readout_time.description: Total readout time in seconds, overriding the sidecar (used without topup).

dwi.description: Corrected 4-D series on the input grid.

gradients.description: dwi_eddy.bval; its sibling dwi_eddy.bvec holds eddy's rotated vectors, so pass this straight to dti-fit.

bvec.description: dwi_eddy.bvec: gradient directions rotated by eddy's motion estimates.

summary.description: volumes, shells, whether topup was applied, engine, repol, movement RMS (mm), outlier slice count.

block.label: Eddy/motion correction (FSL eddy)
block.description: Correct eddy currents and motion, with the topup field.

requirements: FSL 6.0.6 or newer (topup, bet, fslmaths; eddy with eddy_metal, eddy_cuda or eddy_cpu) under FSLDIR, ~/fsl, /usr/local/fsl or /opt/fsl
Python 3.10+ with nibabel and numpy; set NEUROFLOW_PYTHON to the environment
neuroflow/launch.description: python_tool.mjs calls nf_fsl_dwi.eddy(...): writes index.txt (and acqparams.txt when there is no topup), runs $FSLDIR/bin/eddy (or eddy_metal / eddy_cpu) with --topup, --repol and --data_is_shelled as they apply, then delivers the series as dwi_eddy.nii.gz with dwi_eddy.bval and the rotated dwi_eddy.bvec.

useWhen: Correct a diffusion series for eddy currents and head motion before fitting tensors.
Apply a topup field to the whole diffusion series.

avoidWhen.when: You only need distortion correction of b0 images.

preconditions: dwi has a JSON sidecar with PhaseEncodingDirection; with topup_fieldcoef, pass the acqparams from the same fsl-topup run.
mask is on the dwi grid.
effects: Writes dwi_eddy.nii.gz, dwi_eddy.bval and the rotated dwi_eddy.bvec, plus eddy.eddy_movement_rms, eddy.eddy_outlier_map and eddy.eddy_parameters.

duration.basis: Estimate, not measured in the gallery: eddy takes tens of minutes for ~140 volumes on CPU and several times less on a GPU.

failures.remedy: Read the step log; try engine cpu if the GPU build failed.
